referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A full-width landscape photograph at the top, then a large green Read Only heading, a short standfirst, and a paragraph. A right sidebar carries an avatar, name, role, section links, and social icons. The main column continues with a two-column icon list, three accomplishment rows with images, and a contact form. The palette is white, near-black, and green. The typography is a large serif display with a neutral sans body.
